name: angular-translation-service
description: Signal-based Angular i18n library with runtime language switching, SSR hydration, and LLM-powered translation tooling
author: Igor LS

scripts.build:cli: bun packages/cli/scripts/bundle-js-modules.ts && bun build packages/cli/src/index.ts --outdir packages/cli/dist --target node
scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:cli
scripts.publish:all: bun run publish:core && bun run publish:cli
scripts.release: bun run build && bun test && bun run publish:all
